source.name: MADRING
source.widthNote: Published selected corner widths. Placement between measured corners is inferred; most sections use 12 m.
source.elevationNote: Reconstructed 26 m height range. The range is sourced; the longitudinal profile and intermediate heights are inferred, not surveyed.
source.runoffNote: Default gameplay runoff: 20 m of grass on each side, editable per zone. This deliberately differs from real-world safety areas, especially at street circuits.
source.layoutNote: Formula Timer lists 5,414 m; the geographic dataset reports 5,474 m. The mapped centerline is normalized to 5,414 m. Width, banking and height transitions between landmarks are approximated.
